change_log: v19: [calibration-tuning] Empirical threshold recalibration from 618-row CalibrationReport audit.
Five classifiers were stuck on a single value due to threshold mismatches vs observed BTC scale.
scoring.funding_high_positive: 0.0003 -> 0.00003 (3 bp -> 0.3 bp).
scoring.funding_low_positive:  0.00005 -> 0.000005 (0.5 bp -> 0.05 bp).
scoring.funding_high_negative: -0.0003 -> -0.00003.
scoring.funding_low_negative:  -0.00005 -> -0.000005.
indicators.funding.momentum_threshold: 0.0001 -> 0.000005 (10 bp -> 0.5 bp; matches observed max delta of 0.9 bp).
indicators.OI.change_threshold_pct: 0.01 -> 0.003 (1.0% -> 0.3%; observed peak was 0.61%).
indicators.ROC.slope_sensitivity: 0.1 -> 0.05 (conservative halving; affects slope classification,
partial ROC scoring, and Pass 2c activation; 0.03 deferred to v20 if ROCSlope still >80% FLAT).
UI/MainForm_Analysis.vb: GetRecentTradesAsync(100) -> GetRecentTradesAsync(500) (liq window fix).
No new cfg keys. No scoring logic changes. No CSV schema change.
v18: [api-resilience] Added top-level 'network' block (3 keys). DeribitClient wraps all fetches
with ExecuteWithRetry; RunAnalysisAsync validates results and skips cleanly on failure.
network.request_timeout_seconds: 15 -- per-call HttpClient timeout (raised from 10s).
network.retry_count: 1 -- additional retries on 5xx / timeout / network drop.
network.retry_backoff_ms: 1000 -- delay between retries in ms.
GetFundingRateAsync: Double -> Double?  |  GetBookSummaryAsync: tuple -> nullable tuple.
15m cache preserved on fetch failure (stale data better than no data for MTF gate).
Skip counter increments per session; shown in status bar when > 0. No CSV change.
v17: [settings-exposure] Lift 19 hardcoded scoring literals to settings.json. Zero behaviour change at defaults.
scoring.regime_max_score: {trending:19, range_bound:18, transitional:15} -- RegimeMaxScore() base ceilings.
scoring.tier_floor: {high_threshold:12, high_floor:9, med_threshold:9, med_floor:6, low_threshold:6, low_floor:3}
-- TRANSITIONAL ADX penalty graceful-degradation caps.
scoring.context_tag_thresholds: {momentum_fading_decay_ratio:0.5, momentum_fading_count_min:2,
structurally_weak_struct_min:2, structurally_weak_flow_min:2} -- CalcVerdictContext thresholds.
indicators.RSI.pass2c_midline: 50.0 -- RSI midline for Pass 2c RANGE_BOUND alignment check.
indicators.Donchian.quartile_pct: 0.25 -- Donchian channel quartile for LONG/SHORT_PARTIAL classification.
indicators.BBW.series_window_multiplier: 5, squeeze_percentile: 0.20 -- CalcBBW internal parameters.
indicators.TTM.sma_period: 20, lin_reg_period: 7 -- CalcTTMSqueeze internal periods.
indicators.CVD.late_segment_weight: 2.0, early_segment_weight: 1.0 -- 3-segment CVD slope weights.
v16: [swing-pivots] Added indicators.swing block (4 keys) for CalcSwingPivots().
pivot_wing_5m: 3  -- bars left/right confirming a 5m swing (~15 min each side).
lookback_bars_5m: 30  -- scan back ~150 min for most recent confirmed 5m swing.
pivot_wing_15m: 2  -- bars left/right on 15m (~30 min each side).
lookback_bars_15m: 20  -- scan back ~5 hours on 15m for higher-TF context.
No schema changes to other blocks. No scoring impact (display + arbitration + exit only).

v14: [calibration-pass] HIGH-confidence tuning sweep. No schema changes.
S1 OFI:      buy_dominant_ratio 3.0 -> 2.0, sell_dominant_ratio 0.333 -> 0.5 (less aggressive dominance filter).
S2 RSI:      partial_overbought 50.0 -> 55.0, partial_oversold 50.0 -> 45.0 (restore 45-55 dead-band).
S3 Funding:  funding_high_positive 0.0001 -> 0.0003, funding_high_negative -0.0001 -> -0.0003 (BTC routinely sits at 0.01%/8h; extreme-tier should fire less often).
S4 CVD:      slope_min_usd 1000.0 -> 12000.0 (approved interim; 1000 was noise on BTC perp trade flow).
S5 Volume:   dynamic_high_clamp_min 1.5 -> 2.0, dynamic_mid_clamp_min 1.2 -> 1.5 (raise dynamic floor toward trader's 3x breakout rule).
S6 ATR:      static_ref 150.0 -> 115.0 (midpoint of trader-profile Normal band 80-150; removes downward bias on ATRScaleFactor).
S7 MicroCVD: accel_threshold 5000.0 -> 10000.0 (interim static bump; dynamic scaling deferred).
S10 Kelly:   account_size_usd 1000.0 (confirmed; placeholder pending trader input).
v13: [adaptive-regime-weights] Added 'regime_weights' top-level block (Pass 2c).
enabled: true  -- master switch; set false to bypass gate entirely.
trending.alignment_bonus: 1   -- added when EMA+ROC(gated)+CVD all align with direction.
trending.conflict_penalty: 1  -- deducted when all three conflict.
range_bound.alignment_bonus/conflict_penalty: 1/1 for VWAP dev+RSI(9)vs50+Donchian.
TRANSITIONAL: gate suppressed. Zero-net-score run: gate suppressed.
ROC active only when Abs(ROC) >= indicators.ROC.slope_sensitivity.
VWAP active only when VWAP not in warmup (VWAPSessionCandles >= VWAP.warmup_candles).
RegimeMaxScore bumped +1 for TRENDING (19→20) and RANGE_BOUND (18→19).
Verdict % thresholds auto-adjust via Math.Ceiling(regimeMax * pct).
v12: [session-volume-norms] Added top-level 'session_volume' block.
enabled: true  -- master switch; set false to bypass session scaling entirely.
sessions: 3 UTC bucket entries (ASIA 00-07, LONDON 08-12, NY 13-23).
Each bucket carries high_multiplier and mid_multiplier applied to
DynamicNorms.VolHighThreshold / VolMidThreshold after dynamic computation.
ASIA defaults 0.8/0.85 (lower liquidity), LONDON 1.0/1.0 (neutral),
NY 1.15/1.1 (elevated liquidity). Tune after 50+ runs per session.
v11: [oi-cvd-cross-confirm] Added 'oi_cvd_cross' block under 'indicators' with 3 keys:
enabled: true        -- master switch for Pass 2b gate in ScoringEngine_Calculate_Scoring
upgrade_bonus: 1     -- score added when OI full/partial and CVD direction confirm each other
conflict_penalty: 1  -- score deducted when OI full signal and CVD directly oppose
Set upgrade_bonus or conflict_penalty to 0 to disable that half without code change.
v10: [funding-momentum] Added 'funding' block under 'indicators' with 5 keys:
momentum_enabled: true  -- master switch for Step 3b / CalcFundingMomentum()
momentum_window: 3      -- samples back to compare against most recent rate
momentum_threshold: 0.0001 -- min abs delta (1 bp) to classify RISING/FALLING
momentum_amplify: 1     -- extra penalty when momentum confirms crowding
momentum_soften: 1      -- score restored when momentum signals de-crowding
